messages:
Maya (docs): Quick heads-up — a customer hit an error when calling POST /v1/files/ingest. Our API reference currently shows a JSON body with a `content` base64 field and the example curl uses `-H \"Content-Type: application/json\"`. The runtime only accepts multipart `file` uploads (form field name `file`).

Ben (eng): Ugh, that's a leftover from the old prototype. Good catch. We should update the OpenAPI example, the curl snippet, and both JS/Python SDK examples. Also double-check the response schema: I think the example shows `id` but service returns `file_id`.

Lina (sdk): Proposed fixes below. I tested locally with the runtime and this works. Please review and we can push as a small docs PR.

Lina (sdk): Corrected curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/files/ingest\" \\  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\  -H \"Accept: application/json\" \\  -F \"file=@./dataset.csv;type=text/csv\" \\  -F \"metadata={\\\"source\\\":\\\"ingest-test\\\"};type=application/json\"
```

Lina (sdk): Corrected Python snippet (requests):
```python
import requests
url = \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/files/ingest\"
with open('dataset.csv', 'rb') as f:
    files = {'file': ('dataset.csv', f, 'text/csv')}
    data = {'metadata': '{"source":"ingest-test"}'}
    resp = requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {KEY}'}, files=files, data=data)
    print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

Lina (sdk): JS/browser snippet using FormData:
```js
const fd = new FormData();
fd.append('file', fileInput.files[0]);
fd.append('metadata', JSON.stringify({source: 'ingest-test'}));
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/files/ingest', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${KEY}` },
  body: fd
});
console.log(await res.json());
```

Maya (docs): Also, update the OpenAPI example to show `multipart/form-data` and change the response example to match runtime: `{\"file_id\":\"...\", \"status\":\"accepted\"}` (we return 202 for async processing). Add a short note that base64 JSON payloads are NOT supported.

Samir (pm): Do we need a migration note for customers who implemented the old JSON path? Might be worth a short blurb in the changelog and an SDK compatibility note. Also, tests?

Ben (eng): Tests: I'll add a small integration test on the ingestion service side to assert Content-Type handling. Docs: update OpenAPI + examples. SDK: Lina will update snippets in the JS and Python packages and add an example test for the SDK helper.

Maya (docs): I've opened a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — PR includes OpenAPI patch, updated curl + code snippets, and a short migration paragraph. Requesting review from @Ben and @Lina.

docs-bot: PR opened by Maya (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — labels: docs, urgent

Ben (eng): Reviewing now. If OK I'll merge and then Lina can backfill SDK snippet updates in the sdk repos (link them from the docs).

Lina (sdk): I'll prepare small PRs to the JS and Python SDK repos once docs is merged, add a snippet unit test and an end-to-end example in `examples/ingest` folder.

Maya (docs): Action items: 
- [x] Update OpenAPI example to multipart/form-data
- [x] Replace curl + Python + JS snippets in docs PR
- [ ] Add explicit migration note in release notes
- [ ] Add SDK example PRs and link from docs
- [ ] Add ingestion service integration test (Ben)

Samir (pm): Thanks all — this matches customer impact. After we merge, let's ping support and post a short note in #customer-success so existing customers can find the migration guidance.

Maya (docs): Will do. Marking this thread resolved once PR is merged and SDK PRs are open.

Ben (eng): Merged the docs PR and added a one-liner in the API changelog. Lina, flag me if you need any runtime tweaks.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 (merged by Ben)

Lina (sdk): Follow-up PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/678 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/215 — they update examples and tests.
